our_analyses.title: DecodeME summary statistics re-analysed (loci, MAGMA, colocalisation, genetic correlation)
our_analyses.summary_one_line: All 8 DecodeME loci reproduce; genetic signal is enriched in brain tissue and neurons and in none of 29 immune cell types; infection and non-infection onset are genetically the same (rg 0.98); strong overlap with chronic pain (rg 0.45) and depression (rg 0.55).

our_analyses.title: Mendelian randomisation, MVP/FinnGen replication and cis-pQTL protein screen
our_analyses.summary_one_line: Genetically higher IPA, indolelactate, kynurenine, ketones, carnitine or bile acids do not change ME/CFS risk; plasma EPHB1 and CLEC3B are new protein leads that replicate in the Million Veteran Program; DecodeME's genome-wide signal replicates in MVP (rg 0.73) though single loci mostly do not yet.

notes: Unmodified files from OSF. Keep only variants listed in gwas_qced.var.gz (README). A1FREQ_CONTROLS is miscalculated by REGENIE v4.1 (README). Files are not sorted by chromosome.
